pages.title: The Ancient Curse
pages.text: You have discovered the $(egyptian)Ancient Tome$(), a guide to surviving the cursed lands of $(deity)Egypt$().$(br2)These sands hold both great power and terrible danger. The $(curse)Khamsin Curse$() spreads across the land, corrupting all it touches.

pages.title: Your Journey
pages.text: Within this tome you will learn:$(br2)$(li)How to survive the $(curse)curse$()$(li)Crafting $(egyptian)bronze$() tools$(li)The secrets of the $(deity)gods$()$(li)How to face the guardians$(br2)May $(deity)Ra$() guide your path.
